title: sdv-website
summary: A small Flask web application that lets a user upload a tabular dataset, then generates a synthetic version of it for download, drawing on SDGym's tablegan baseline code as well. The app directly imports SDV's CTGAN synthesizer and demo dataset loader from the sdv.tabular and sdv.demo modules to produce the synthetic output.
